description:
Once the emitted answer provably equals the replayed answer, delete the inference: the interval rule (reads UNION previous blocked-set, movement in [previous conclusion, t)) and the shadow types that exist only to track it -- Movement, WaitIdentity, WaitLookup, FormulaHistory and the per-formula position bookkeeping in Replay.

SCOPE HONESTLY. impl Replay is 669 lines but they are not all causality. Product settlement/generation/cache-hit tallies, FactLifecycle (first_appearances > distinct = retract-and-remint), ShiftWork and session tallies are straight folds over already-emitted events; they stay, restructured as tallies. Split the 669 before estimating; do not quote it as the deletion.

Also delete the permanent reads-only red test. It exists to stop someone simplifying an inference rule that will no longer exist.

KEEP a small backing assertion in its place: every emitted cause must appear in that same stream's own changed/movements. That preserves the one rationale that survives -- the engine should not be the only witness to its own good behaviour -- at a size where a failure is unambiguous. Today instrument and audit are the same code, so a non-zero uncaused count cannot distinguish 'the compiler did extra work' from 'the replayer's model is stale'.
title: Delete the causality inference and its interval shadow state
